description: This file contains functions and types related to resolving session keys based on various parameters, including session ID, label, and key, within a gateway context. It handles session visibility, validation, and retrieval logic.

methods.name: resolveSessionVisibilityFilterOptions
methods.description: Constructs visibility filter options based on provided session resolve parameters.

methods.name: noSessionFoundResult
methods.description: Returns a SessionsResolveResult indicating no session was found for the given key.

methods.name: isResolvedSessionKeyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a session key is visible based on the current visibility filters and session store.

methods.name: resolveSessionKeyFromResolveParams
methods.description: Main exported function that resolves a session key based on provided parameters, handling key, sessionId, and label cases.
